notes: Need IDs are private semantic retrieval aids, not app question IDs.
Filter entries by released stage and resolve corrected source revisions before use.
When older sources are superseded, use an updated eligible entry or explicitly historical source context; never silently treat the withdrawn inference as current.
Unavailable answers do not reveal a future-record inventory.

entries.information_need: What fell, where, and who was exposed at the time?
example_phrasings: What happened and was anyone exposed?

sources.exact_excerpt: Nobody was working in the pit at that moment; contractors had worked there during the morning.

entries.factual_answer: Beam and link fell into the pit onto sled/scaffold. Earlier pit work and occupancy at the fall are distinct.

coverage.qualification: Covered only at the source scope.
Covered only at the source scope.
No complete injury or cost assessment supplied.

does_not_establish: No quantified loss or proof of all possible exposure routes.

entries.information_need: What configuration and work preceded the fall?

sources.exact_excerpt: Work rolls and top and bottom backup rolls had been removed on the previous shift.
The R3 top backup-roll balance was left raised.
No crane lift involving this assembly was in progress at the fall or reported earlier in the relevant outage work.

entries.factual_answer: Rolls were removed and balance raised for outage work; no involved crane lift is reported.

coverage.qualification: Covered only at the source scope.
Covered only at the source scope.
Covered only at the source scope.

does_not_establish: Configuration alone does not establish disengagement mechanism.

entries.information_need: Was the keeper present, and was it adequate?
example_phrasings: Was the retaining device fitted and tested?

sources.exact_excerpt: The keeper was still installed and the link appeared intact.

entries.factual_answer: Keeper installed and link apparently intact in initial visual check. Capacity and incident-time engagement are not established by this check.

coverage.qualification: Covered only at the source scope.
Visual scene record does not establish capacity or pre-event torque.

does_not_establish: Intact does not mean adequate in every relative position.

entries.information_need: What does the zero reading establish?

sources.exact_excerpt: The prior-shift line reads “header gauge zero after bleed.”
I was at the desk and did not check the beam/yoke position or a load-side gauge.

entries.factual_answer: Prior-shift header reading was reported zero. Desk immobility statement is an unverified interpretation of that same record, not a second measurement.

coverage.qualification: Covered only at the source scope.
Header-only reading; circuit scope not established by this source.

does_not_establish: No proof of zero cylinder pressure or mechanical restraint.

entries.information_need: Did beam and yoke move together?
example_phrasings: How much did the beam and yoke move?

sources.exact_excerpt: | P2 | 12:10 | Same housing reference | Lower than P1 | No calibrated distance |
| P3 | 13:02 | Still at housing; lateral offset apparent relative to Y | Lower than P2 | Link/keeper contact obscured |

entries.factual_answer: Yoke marker is lower while beam remains at the housing reference; later offset is visible. Distances and concealed contacts are unavailable.

coverage.qualification: Covered only at the source scope.
No distance calibration supplied.

does_not_establish: No exact contact sequence or drift rate.

entries.information_need: What retention geometry and restraints were observed?
example_phrasings: How could an intact keeper allow release?

sources.exact_excerpt: | Yoke lower relative to carrier; link laterally offset | A path exists past the retaining edge while the keeper remains attached |
No independent mechanical restraint was found on the accessible recovered assembly or exposed yoke region.

entries.factual_answer: Unloaded review found a clearance path at the recorded relative position with keeper attached. No independent restraint was found in the accessible surveyed region.

coverage.qualification: Covered only at the source scope.
Accessible post-event survey and visible region only.

does_not_establish: Not a rated test, numeric clearance or proof that every hidden restraint was absent.

example_phrasings: Did the liner knock it loose?

sources.exact_excerpt: A small liner from the top operator-side window was found with the fallen assembly.
I cannot say whether the liner moved first.

entries.factual_answer: A liner was found with the assembly; the witness cannot establish which moved first.

coverage.qualification: Covered only at the source scope.
Witness cannot see hidden contact or order separation.

entries.information_need: Which pressure volume and leakage path were examined?
example_phrasings: Could oil leave the loaded side and how fast?

sources.exact_excerpt: G-H is on the header side of IV-R3, not on the isolated cylinder side.
With the valve handle in its closed indication, the workshop observation recorded fluid passing from the port identified as the former load-side connection toward the former header connection.

entries.factual_answer: Header gauge does not measure cylinder-side pressure. Later closed-handle IV-R3 examination recorded load-to-header passing; event-time rate and other cylinder paths remain unresolved.

coverage.qualification: Covered only at the source scope.
Covered only at the source scope.
No calibrated event-time flow measurement.

does_not_establish: Not exclusive hydraulic root cause or historical raw test.

entries.information_need: What did the issued task record establish about gravity control?
example_phrasings: What restraint method was required and recorded?

sources.exact_excerpt: For work involving a raised assembly, the task record identifies the assembly/configuration, the method intended to control gravity movement and the person verifying that method.
No configuration-specific attachment identifying a gravity-control method was included with this issued sheet.

entries.factual_answer: Required task-specific gravity-control method and verification are not documented in the supplied issued sheet/attachments. Complete physical arrangement is not established by the omission.

coverage.qualification: Covered only at the source scope.
Covered only at the source scope.
Document omission is not physical absence.

does_not_establish: No motive, training deficiency or proof of absent hardware from blanks.

entries.information_need: What did the desk correction change?

sources.exact_excerpt: I withdraw my earlier inference that the raised balance could not move hydraulically.
The prior-shift header indication remains as recorded.

entries.factual_answer: Revision 2 withdraws immobility inference but preserves the reported header indication.

coverage.qualification: Covered only at the source scope.
Covered only at the source scope.

does_not_establish: Does not erase other scene evidence.

entries.information_need: Why did the component or task-control gap originate?

subparts.information_need: People's motives or complete organizational root cause

entries.factual_answer: The supplied records do not establish defect origin, individual motive or a complete organizational explanation.

coverage.qualification: No origin record supplied.
No supported account available.
